page.layout: One column of running text, with small marginal notes in the right margin. The left margin holds only show-through and the edge of the neighbouring page, which are not transcribed. Below the text: catchword at right and gathering signature at left.

main_text.p: inde Appianus, & exponit varios ac dif-ficiles Romanorum labores exantlatos, dum eniterentur in arcem, in viis pari-ter & domorum tectis planis, in quæ evaserant, contra eos, qui se objicie-bant, depugnantes: describitque graphicè plusquàm miserabilem & verè lamentabilem faciem & fragorè ruentis Carthaginis, urbis maximæ & paulo ante florentissimæ ac splendidissimæ, & omnis generis casus lugubres, ac varias acerbasque mortes pereuntium hominum, ut neminem ea legere sine dolore[illegible, ~3 letters] & gemitu posse, qui ferreus non sit[illegible, ~3 letters], exiltimem[?]. Scipio certè victor, ut testatus est, qui præsens ei adstitit; Polybius[illegible, ~3 letters] cum cadentem, & ardentem urbem[illegible, ~3 letters] potentiâ nuper maximis regibus parem, animis audaciaque etiam superiorem intueretur, lachrumas fudit, & hostium tam acerbam fortunam deflevit[illegible, ~3 letters] recordatusque inconstantiæ & vicissitudinis rerum humanarum, idem aliquando accidere posse patriæ suæ Romæ[illegible, ~3 letters] metuere se falsus fuit. Quod quidem non abs re metuisse animum ejus præsagum, eventus sub Totila Gotthorum rege tandem probavit. page.notes: The right-margin notes are tiny, faint and mostly illegible; their positions are marked, but their letters could not be read, so they are shown as illegible. The doubtful word "exiltimem" at the end of the first sentence is marked [?]. The catchword "venisse" completes the half-word "pe-" at the line end. The left margin edge marks are show-through or the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.
